title: Arm Nerve Injuries — Radial, Median, Ulnar, Axillary and More

hook.en: A hand that drops, claws or won't oppose the thumb is a picture-diagnosis. Learn the classic deformity, the quick test and the usual injury site for each nerve of the arm.
hook.ur: Jo haath latak jaye, claw ban jaye ya thumb oppose na kare, woh tasveer se pehchana jata hai. Arm ki har nerve ke liye classic deformity, tez test aur injury ki aam jagah seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll name the injury sign, the quick motor test and the usual site of injury for the radial, median, ulnar, axillary, musculocutaneous, long thoracic and spinal accessory nerves.
goal.ur: End tak aap radial, median, ulnar, axillary, musculocutaneous, long thoracic aur spinal accessory nerves ke liye injury sign, tez motor test aur aam injury site batayenge.

text.en: Each peripheral nerve has three things worth knowing: its **motor job** (what it moves), its **autonomous sensory zone** (the skin only it supplies) and its **vulnerable site** (where it is trapped or hurt). Once you know those three, a patient's story ("slept with my arm over the chair", "fell on my shoulder") and a quick bedside test usually name the nerve.
text.ur: Har peripheral nerve ke baare mein teen cheezein jaanna zaroori hain: iska **motor kaam** (kya hilati hai), iska **autonomous sensory zone** (woh skin jo sirf wohi supply karti hai) aur iski **vulnerable jagah** (jahan yeh dabti ya zakhmi hoti hai). Yeh teen jaan lein to patient ki kahani (“kursi par arm rakh kar so gaya”, “kandhay par gira”) aur ek tez bedside test aam taur par nerve ka naam bata deta hai.

text.en: A nerve is a garden hose. It leaks or kinks at the same places every time: where it bends round a bone (radial at the spiral groove), squeezes through a tunnel (median at the carpal tunnel), or runs close to the skin (ulnar at the "funny bone"). Knowing the weak points tells you where to look.
text.ur: Nerve garden hose hai. Yeh har baar un hi jagahon par leak ya kink hoti hai: jahan haddi ke gird mur'ti hai (spiral groove par radial), surang se guzarti hai (carpal tunnel mein median) ya skin ke qareeb chalti hai (“funny bone” par ulnar). Kamzor jagahein jaan kar aap ko pata hota hai kahan dekhna hai.

intro.en: Follow the radial nerve's course down the back of the arm, round the **spiral groove** of the humerus and into the forearm. The demo plays the healthy movement first, then the injured one: watch for **wrist drop**.
intro.ur: Radial nerve ka raasta arm ki peeth par, humerus ke **spiral groove** ke gird aur forearm tak follow karein. Demo pehle healthy, phir injured movement chalata hai: **wrist drop** dekhein.

intro.en: Follow the median nerve through the **carpal tunnel**. The healthy movement plays first, then the injured one: the thumb stays flat in the palm (**ape hand**). Ask yourself which muscles waste.
intro.ur: Median nerve ko **carpal tunnel** se guzarte hue follow karein. Pehle healthy, phir injured movement chalti hai: thumb palm mein flat reh jata hai (**ape hand**). Sochein kaun se muscles waste hote hain.

intro.en: Follow the ulnar nerve behind the medial epicondyle (the **cubital tunnel**). In the injured half of the loop, look for the **claw hand** of the ring and little fingers.
intro.ur: Ulnar nerve ko medial epicondyle ke peechay (**cubital tunnel**) follow karein. Loop ke injured hissay mein ring aur little fingers ka **claw hand** dekhein.

title.en: Radial, median, ulnar at a glance
title.ur: Radial, median, ulnar ek nazar mein

headers.en: Quick test and sign when injured
headers.ur: Tez test aur chot lagne par sign

rows.en: Radial
rows.ur: Radial

rows.en: Wrist and finger extension ("stop" sign); WRIST DROP; numb first dorsal web space
rows.ur: Wrist aur finger extension (“stop” sign); WRIST DROP; pehli dorsal web sunn

rows.en: Spiral groove after a mid-shaft humeral fracture, or "Saturday-night palsy"
rows.ur: Mid-shaft humerus fracture ke baad spiral groove, ya “Saturday-night palsy”

rows.en: Median
rows.ur: Median

rows.en: Thumb abduction ("point to the ceiling") and the "OK" sign; APE HAND, thenar wasting; numb index fingertip
rows.ur: Thumb abduction (“chhat ki taraf point”) aur “OK” sign; APE HAND, thenar wasting; index fingertip sunn

rows.en: Carpal tunnel (most common); high lesions at the elbow
rows.ur: Carpal tunnel (sab se aam); elbow par high lesions

rows.en: Ulnar
rows.ur: Ulnar

rows.en: Finger spreading and Froment's paper grip; CLAW HAND of ring and little fingers; numb little fingertip
rows.ur: Finger phailana aur Froment ka kagaz pakarna; ring aur little fingers ka CLAW HAND; little fingertip sunn

rows.en: Cubital tunnel at the elbow (most common); Guyon's canal at the wrist
rows.ur: Elbow par cubital tunnel (sab se aam); wrist par Guyon's canal

question.en: A man wakes after sleeping with his arm over the back of a chair. He cannot extend his wrist or fingers and there is a numb patch over the back of the first web space. Which nerve?
question.ur: Aadmi kursi ki pusht par arm rakh kar sone ke baad uthta hai. Woh wrist ya fingers extend nahi kar sakta aur pehli web ki peeth par sunn patch hai. Kaun si nerve?

text.en: Radial nerve at the spiral groove (wrist drop)
text.ur: Spiral groove par radial nerve (wrist drop)

feedback.en: Yes — "Saturday-night palsy": compression of the radial nerve against the humerus. Triceps is spared because the nerve to it leaves higher up.
feedback.ur: Haan — “Saturday-night palsy”: radial nerve ka humerus ke khilaf dabna. Triceps mehfooz rehta hai kyunke uski nerve upar se nikal chuki hoti hai.

text.en: Median nerve at the carpal tunnel

feedback.en: That causes weak thumb abduction and numb index fingertip, not wrist drop.
feedback.ur: Is se thumb abduction kamzor aur index fingertip sunn hoti hai, wrist drop nahi.

feedback.en: That causes clawing of the ring and little fingers.
feedback.ur: Is se ring aur little fingers ka clawing hota hai.

text.en: **The ulnar paradox.** A *low* ulnar lesion (at the wrist) gives *more* clawing than a *high* one (at the elbow). In a high lesion the ulnar half of FDP is also paralysed, so the fingertips cannot curl and the claw looks milder even though more is lost. Do not judge the severity by how dramatic the hand looks.
text.ur: **Ulnar paradox.** *Low* ulnar lesion (wrist par) *high* lesion (elbow par) se *zyada* clawing deta hai. High lesion mein FDP ka ulnar half bhi paralyse ho jata hai, is liye fingertips curl nahi ho sakti aur claw halka lagta hai, halankeh nuksan zyada hai. Haath kitna dramatic lagta hai us se severity ka andaza na lagayein.

intro.en: Follow the axillary nerve round the **surgical neck of the humerus**. In the injured half of the loop the arm cannot be lifted out to the side and the "regimental badge" patch over the deltoid is numb.
intro.ur: Axillary nerve ko **humerus ki surgical neck** ke gird follow karein. Loop ke injured hissay mein arm side mein nahi uth sakta aur deltoid ke upar “regimental badge” patch sunn hota hai.

title.ur: Arm aur shoulder ki doosri nerves

rows.en: Axillary (C5–C6)
rows.ur: Axillary (C5–C6)

rows.en: Deltoid: cannot abduct beyond the first 15°; flat deltoid
rows.ur: Deltoid: shuru ke 15° ke baad abduct nahi; deltoid flat

rows.en: Shoulder dislocation, surgical-neck fracture
rows.ur: Shoulder dislocation, surgical-neck fracture

rows.en: Musculocutaneous (C5–C7)
rows.ur: Musculocutaneous (C5–C7)

rows.en: Biceps and brachialis: weak elbow flexion and supination; numb lateral forearm
rows.ur: Biceps aur brachialis: elbow flexion aur supination kamzor; lateral forearm sunn

rows.en: Pierces coracobrachialis; shoulder dislocation, humeral fracture
rows.ur: Coracobrachialis ko cheerti hai; shoulder dislocation, humerus fracture

rows.en: Long thoracic (C5–C7)
rows.ur: Long thoracic (C5–C7)

rows.en: Serratus anterior: WINGING of the scapula, worse pushing against a wall
rows.ur: Serratus anterior: scapula ki WINGING, wall ko dhakelne par zyada

rows.en: Runs on the chest wall: axillary surgery, mastectomy, heavy loads
rows.ur: Chest wall par chalti hai: axillary surgery, mastectomy, bhaari bojh

rows.en: Spinal accessory (CN XI)
rows.ur: Spinal accessory (CN XI)

rows.en: Trapezius and sternocleidomastoid: drooping shoulder, weak shrug
rows.ur: Trapezius aur sternocleidomastoid: shoulder latakna, shrug kamzor

rows.en: Posterior triangle of the neck: biopsy or neck dissection
rows.ur: Gardan ka posterior triangle: biopsy ya neck dissection

question.en: After a mastectomy a woman notices the inner border of her scapula sticking out when she pushes her hand against a wall. Which nerve?
question.ur: Mastectomy ke baad khatoon dekhti hain ke deewar par haath se dhakelne par scapula ka inner border bahar nikalta hai. Kaun si nerve?

feedback.en: Yes — it runs along the chest wall and is easily injured in axillary surgery.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh chest wall ke saath chalti hai aur axillary surgery mein asani se zakhmi hoti hai.

feedback.en: That causes a drooping shoulder and lateral winging, with weak shrug, not medial winging on wall push-up.
feedback.ur: Is se shoulder latakta hai aur lateral winging hoti hai, shrug kamzor hota hai; wall push-up par medial winging nahi.

feedback.en: The axillary nerve supplies deltoid; abduction is lost, not scapular winging.
feedback.ur: Axillary nerve deltoid ko supply karti hai; abduction jati hai, scapular winging nahi.

text.en: **Autonomous zones** give a clear sensory answer: index fingertip (median), little fingertip (ulnar), first dorsal web space (radial), lateral upper arm (axillary). In practice test the zone, test the key muscle, then decide: nerve (a territory), root (a dermatome) or plexus (a mix). Splints (a wrist cock-up splint for wrist drop, a night splint for carpal tunnel) protect the joint while the nerve recovers — about 1 mm a day.
text.ur: **Autonomous zones** sensory sawal ka saaf jawab dete hain: index fingertip (median), little fingertip (ulnar), pehli dorsal web (radial), lateral upper arm (axillary). Practice mein zone test karein, key muscle test karein, phir faisla karein: nerve (territory), root (dermatome) ya plexus (mix). Splints (wrist drop ke liye wrist cock-up splint, carpal tunnel ke liye night splint) nerve ke theek hone tak joint ki hifazat karte hain — takriban 1 mm roz.

question.en: A patient has weak thumb abduction **and** weak thumb flexion (FPL) with numb index fingertip. Is it carpal tunnel?
question.ur: Patient ka thumb abduction **aur** thumb flexion (FPL) kamzor hain aur index fingertip sunn hai. Kya yeh carpal tunnel hai?

answer.en: Probably not. The carpal tunnel affects only the muscles supplied **after** the tunnel (APB, but not FPL, which branches higher up). Weak FPL and pronator teres too point to a **higher median lesion** (forearm or elbow) — or even a C7–C8 root. Find the muscle that shares the root but not the nerve.
answer.ur: Shayad nahi. Carpal tunnel sirf un muscles ko affect karta hai jo tunnel ke **baad** supply hotay hain (APB, lekin FPL nahi jo upar se branch hota hai). FPL aur pronator teres bhi kamzor hon to yeh **zyada upar ki median lesion** (forearm ya elbow) — ya C7–C8 root ho sakti hai. Aisa muscle dhoondein jo root share kare magar nerve nahi.

question.en: Which statement about the autonomous zone is correct?
question.ur: Autonomous zone ke baare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?

text.en: It is the patch of skin supplied by only one nerve, so testing there gives the clearest answer
text.ur: Yeh skin ka woh patch hai jo sirf ek nerve se supply hota hai, is liye wahan test karne se sab se saaf jawab milta hai

feedback.en: Yes — neighbouring nerves overlap elsewhere, so a loss in the autonomous zone is the reliable one.
feedback.ur: Haan — baqi jagahon par qareeb ki nerves overlap karti hain, is liye autonomous zone ki kami hi bharosay ki hai.

text.en: It is the whole area a nerve touches, including overlap
text.ur: Yeh poora area hai jahan nerve pohnchti hai, overlap samet

feedback.en: That is the maximal territory; overlap makes loss patchy.
feedback.ur: Yeh maximal territory hai; overlap kami ko patchy bana deta hai.

text.en: It only matters for motor nerves
text.ur: Yeh sirf motor nerves ke liye ahem hai

feedback.en: Autonomous zones are a sensory concept.

text.en: **Refer urgently** for a sudden foot or wrist drop with severe pain, a nerve deficit after trauma with an open wound, a cold pale hand (vascular injury), or weakness that is rapidly spreading. Acute compartment syndrome and expanding haematoma can both injure nerves within hours.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** agar achanak foot ya wrist drop shadeed dard ke saath ho, trauma ke baad khuli chot ke saath nerve ki kami ho, thanda peela haath (vascular injury), ya kamzori tezi se phail rahi ho. Acute compartment syndrome aur barhta haematoma dono ghanton mein nerves ko zakhmi kar sakte hain.

summary.en: For each nerve know three things: motor job, autonomous sensory zone and vulnerable site.
summary.ur: Har nerve ke liye teen cheezein jaanein: motor kaam, autonomous sensory zone aur vulnerable jagah.

summary.en: Classic pictures: radial = wrist drop, median = ape hand, ulnar = claw hand, long thoracic = medial winging, axillary = flat deltoid.
summary.ur: Classic tasveerein: radial = wrist drop, median = ape hand, ulnar = claw hand, long thoracic = medial winging, axillary = flat deltoid.

summary.en: Separate nerve from root by testing a muscle that shares the root but not the nerve; protect the joint and refer urgent or traumatic losses.
summary.ur: Nerve ko root se alag karne ke liye aisa muscle test karein jo root share kare magar nerve nahi; joint ki hifazat karein aur urgent ya trauma wali kami ko refer karein.

front.en: Radial nerve lesion at the spiral groove: what do you see?
front.ur: Spiral groove par radial nerve lesion: kya nazar aata hai?

back.en: Wrist drop (cannot extend wrist and fingers), numb first dorsal web space; triceps is spared.
back.ur: Wrist drop (wrist aur fingers extend nahi), pehli dorsal web sunn; triceps mehfooz.

front.ur: Ape hand kis wajah se hota hai?

back.en: A median nerve lesion (commonly at the carpal tunnel): thumb stays flat in the palm and the thenar muscles waste.
back.ur: Median nerve lesion (aam taur par carpal tunnel): thumb palm mein flat reh jata hai aur thenar muscles waste hote hain.

back.en: A paper held between thumb and index finger: the thumb IP flexes (FPL, median) to compensate for weak adductor pollicis (ulnar).
back.ur: Thumb aur index ke beech kagaz: thumb ka IP flex hota hai (FPL, median) jo kamzor adductor pollicis (ulnar) ki jagah leta hai.

front.en: Which nerve causes medial winging of the scapula?
front.ur: Scapula ki medial winging kaun si nerve se hoti hai?

back.en: The long thoracic nerve (serratus anterior). Lateral winging is the spinal accessory nerve (trapezius).
back.ur: Long thoracic nerve (serratus anterior). Lateral winging spinal accessory nerve (trapezius) se hoti hai.
